newsitem.title: USA: Arizona police find van filled with dead scorpions.
newsitem.headline: Arizona police find van filled with dead scorpions.

text.p: U.S. customs officials inspecting a van at the Mexican border found an ice chest filled with thousands of scorpions after a drug-sniffing dog started growling, officials said on Friday.
There were 12,700 dead scorpions packed on ice in the box and a nearby water cooler, a spokesman for the U.S. Customs Service said on Friday.
"It was certainly surprising and something that I had never seen in my years with Customs," said Max Pitzer, director of the border-crossing at San Luis in southwestern Arizona.
An agency spokesman, Roger Maier in El Paso, Texas, said the discovery on Thursday was surprising, but he could not say if it was illegal to bring dead scorpions into the country.
The case had been turned over to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Department to investigate, he said. A spokesman for that agency was not immediately available.

Maier said the driver of the van was an Arizona resident who had not entered the country illegally, although he failed to declare the scorpions, which ranged in length from one inch to three inches (2.5 to 7.5 cms).
He speculated the arachnids might be used in southwestern-motif decorations or varnished and mounted in such items as paper weights.
Although he had never seen such a case before, Maier said it was not the most unusual. "We've had cases of people who tried to smuggle live snakes in their pants," he said.
